metadata.description: Full eight-node Walk network, Liu et al. 2025 equations and Table 6/7; all nodes integrated simultaneously with RK4. Display a periodic-oscillation segment after approximately 10 seconds of startup; small cycle modulation remains, so this is not claimed to be an exactly repeated limit cycle. Internal model states, not joint angles.
metadata.scaling: X=x, Y=10*y, Z=30*z. Scaled Y and Z both follow X; original feedback is u=fc-200*Y+(2000/30)*Z.
notes: r is algebraic sigmoid target; x is dynamic state.
Peak-to-peak period inferred numerically, not hard-coded.
Signed derivative dx=10*(r-x) determines x movement, not a joint angle or angular velocity.
u_dot=fc_dot+2000*(Y-Z) and fc_dot=-6*dx4-4*dx5 exactly for Walk node1.
Derivative values in this file are continuous ODE right-hand sides, not finite-difference decoder features.

fixed_target_control.description: Pedagogical intervention: same initial x/y/z as the actual oscillatory window, but replace the recomputed target with r=0.8 for all time. Coupled-neighbor drive and internal feedback no longer set r. This is not another gait or a robot-angle prediction.
fixed_target_control.time_reference: same absolute timestamps as actual-network rows; elapsed time tau=t-window_start
fixed_target_control.note: u=logit(0.8) is a forced constant input, not fc-2000*y+2000*z here.
